author: DJI
description:
They return to the coast to help those caught in what’s been left behind.
Abandoned fishing gear and plastic waste can entangle marine life. With patience and care, the Ocean Conservation Namibia team frees Cape fur seals and helps them return to the sea. Captured with #Osmo360II and #OsmoAction6, bringing the rescue into view from different perspectives.

*Footage shows Ocean Conservation Namibia (OCN) professionals rescuing entangled Cape fur seals.

*Performed by trained professionals. Please do not attempt.

🎬 oceanconservationnamibia
#DJI #360Camera #ActionCamera #OceanConservation #Wildlife #Namibia
title: Into the Rescue Zone | DJI Osmo Action 6 & DJI Osmo 360 II
